items.title: How verification checks an ad
steps: An ad is served on a page
A verification tag loads with it
It collects page, viewability and device signals
It checks them against the buyer’s rules
A report shows where the ad ran
The buyer blocks poor places next time
items.why: The tag gathers the facts, the rules judge them, and the report guides the next buy.

items.title: How a publisher handles a bad ad
steps: A visitor reports a bad ad
Ad ops collects the screenshot and details
They find the buyer and creative it came from
They block the creative or advertiser
They confirm it no longer appears
items.why: Collect proof, trace the source, block it, tell the partner and confirm.
